I am old now, 63 years, and I farm this maize plot alone with help from my children when they come. I always plant maize because it is our food, and I intercrop with pigeon pea or beans to help the soil and have something to eat with nsima. If I get the FISP coupon this year I will use the NPK and urea, but only a small amount because the plot is not so big and I must be careful. I cannot afford pesticides, and there is no irrigation here in Salima — we wait for the rains.
